completion.on_correction: When Shawn corrects your work, the activation failed. Write the new law down that hour so the next activation carries it. A lesson not written is a lesson he'll teach twice.
completion.rule: All required steps pass before work begins. If any check fails, stop — do not proceed hoping it won't matter.

description: Machine-readable activation checklist. A Naya (or her worker) loads this file, walks each step in order, and verifies each check before proceeding. Every step must pass — activation is a MUST, not optional. This is the procedure; the receipt (filled after) is a separate artifact.

steps.action: Read the standing laws from source, not from memory. Minimum: AGENTS.md (operating rules), MEMORY.md (user, preferences, doctrine), the task brief (full).

checks.check: AGENTS.md read at current main tip
checks.verify: record the SHA or timestamp of the version read

checks.check: MEMORY.md key sections read (user, preferences, doctrine, commitments)
checks.verify: name one preference and one commitment relevant to this task
restate the task in one sentence without looking

steps.name: TUNE IN — load the laws fresh

steps.action: Establish what is true RIGHT NOW: current main tip SHA, open blockers on your lane, what's moving that touches your work.

checks.verify: 40-hex SHA, verified against live remote (not cached)

checks.check: no conflicting active lane on this work
checks.verify: board claim scan run, or open-PRs checked for same-class work

steps.name: TUNE IN — load current project state

steps.action: Write one sentence: what is the REAL outcome Shawn wants? Not the literal instruction — the outcome.

checks.verify: sentence names a human-experienced result, not a file or PR

steps.name: NAME THE JOB

steps.action: Write down which laws govern THIS specific task. Name them explicitly — vague 'follow the laws' is not activation.

checks.verify: at least 2 specific laws/rules cited by name or number
if task touches design, DESIGN-ACTIVATION.md steps completed

steps.name: NAME THE GATES

steps.action: State how you will verify the result through HIS eyes, not your build environment. What will he open, see, hear?

checks.verify: method describes his experience (screenshot, open file, read aloud), not your test output

steps.name: NAME THE PROOF

steps.action: Load the instruments this job needs: block library catalog for design work, relevant specs, current data sources.

checks.check: block catalog consulted for design work
checks.verify: if task involves visual output, blocks/index.json read and candidate blocks named
if an official block/spec/mechanism exists for this job, it is named — custom builds justified in writing

steps.name: PICK UP THE TOOLS
